messages:
mira: Quick sync — prepping zeta-14b for onboarding. Can someone confirm the canonical HF repo vs our S3 mirror path? Need to run tokenizer sanity and checksum before PR.

alex: HF repo is `redwood-models/zeta-14b-v0`. Canonical S3 path we mirror to is `s3://rw-artifacts/models/zeta-14b/v0/` — manifests live next to shards.

mira: thanks. who has perms to generate presigned urls for the validator job? need one with ~1h TTL for CI.

pranav: I can generate. FYI CI expects manifest.json + all shard objects present. Run `jq -S . manifest.json` to normalize before checksum.

sasha: tokenizer note — model was trained with an older bpe config. tokenization output includes a stray BOS token on sequences with leading spaces; tokenizer tests should strip leading whitespace and assert no BOS at start. I have a quick test snippet.

mira: plz paste snippet?

sasha: ```python
# quick sanity check
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
 tok = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
def sanity(text):
    ids = tok.encode(text).ids
    return ids[0] != tok.token_to_id('<bos>')
print(sanity(' hello'))
```

alex: lgtm. Also check shard ordering — our loader expects zero-padded shards: `weights-00000-of-00032.bin`. If upstream uses non-padded names we rewrite manifest.

mira: good call. On checksum: upstream provides sha256 for each shard? hf has `s3://hf-cache/.../zeta-14b/weights-00001.bin` with etag but not sha256. Any recommended flow?

pranav: We do mirror-and-verify: copy from HF origin into a staging bucket, compute sha256, write it to manifest.sha256, then atomically move into final prefix. If checksum mismatch, abort and alert. I'll kick off a dry-run.

ingest-bot: dry-run started by @pranav for `redwood-models/zeta-14b-v0` -> staging `s3://rw-staging/zeta-14b/v0/` (jobs/3492).

jordan: heads-up — if we rewrite manifest to add zero-padded names we should also include `orig_path` field so origin provenance is preserved for debugging.

mira: agreed. pranaV? (typoed) pranav: i'll include `orig_path` and `origin_etag` in the manifest entries. Also add `manifest_ver: 2` so loaders detect the shim.

pranav: done. dry-run reports one missing shard (weights-00009-of-00032.bin) on HF origin — 404. Possible partial upload.

alex: hmm. Could be multipart upload still pending or renamed. @sasha did you see any related upload notes?

sasha: nope. I'll open an HF issue but in parallel we can request upstream to re-publish. For now we can mark manifest entry as `status: pending` so onboarding CI skips until present.

mira: ok. can you create PR with manifest changes + tokenizer test + README notes? ping code review when ready. I can review asap.

pranav: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-registry/pull/618 — adds manifest_v2, orig_path, origin_etag, tokenizer sanity test, and preserves shard ordering. Marked missing shard as pending.

alex: reviewing now. quick note on presign: ops-bot will create presigned urls that expire in 3600s by default.

ops-bot: presigned urls created for manifest and available shards (where present) with TTL=3600s. Links sent to @pranav via DM.

mira: thanks. last ask — who will re-run the checksum/ingest once HF re-uploads shard 9?

pranav: i'll watch the HF issue and re-run the dry-run. ingest-bot has a resume hook: `jobs/3492/resume` once all shards present.

ingest-bot: resume hook documented at https://internal.docs/ingest/resume. Use `ingest-bot resume jobs/3492` when ready.

mira: perfect. tagging this thread for onboarding audit. @alex @sasha @pranav — if we get green dry-run + CI tokenizer pass I will proceed to onboard to staging. :thumbsup:

alex: :+1:

sasha: :thumbsup:

mira: thanks everyone — will follow up in PR comments and HF issue.
